buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to

50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The technical evaluation of bid will be done as per the criteria uploaded by the railways. TENDERERS ARE REQUESTED TO UPLOAD THE DOCUMENTS IN THE GIVEN FOLLOWING ORDER FO R EVALUATION:- 1. Affidavit for Sole proprietorship/ Partnership deed /MOA /AOA 2. Power of attorney 3. Mandate form 4. GSTIN 5. PAN details 6. Financial Turnover as per the tender & GCC condition (i.e. Last three financial years Balance sheets certi fied by CA). 7. Completion certificate of similar nature work for as per the tender & GCC condition. 8. Affidavit for documents to be uploaded by the tenderer as per the given format by railways. 9. Any other tender related documents. 10. Startup firms as approved by Railway Board or HQ or DRM/ BPL will be given relaxation in eligibility crit eria and core activity of startup may also be seen. 11. Tenderers are advised to go through the Scope of work before bidding. 12. Tenderers are advised to fill Annexure/ affidavit/ certificate as mentioned in scope of work. 13. In case of multiple L-1 GeM latest criteria (GTC page No. 16 for Run L1) will be followed. 14. In case of any querry tenderers are advised to go through the Bid form sheet of GCC Services 2018 sub mission of documents or can contact to this office. 15. In case of any difference between tender document and GCC services 2018 & amendments, The GCC s ervices and amendments will prevail. 16. For EMD Submission Bidder has to submit the original Bank Guarantee/ FDR in the name of Sr. DFM/ BP L/ WCR & should be delivered in person to the official nominated as indicated in the tender document befo re closing date for submission of bids (Le. excluding the last date of submission of bids). .
